posts.title: Apple II Agent: An AI coding environment for the Apple II
posts.description: I recently revived an open source Apple II Agent project I began in January: An Apple IIe with a custom client that allows AI to easily write software through a chat taking place on the machine itself, similar to Anthropic’s Claude Code. Through an Ethernet card, the client links to Anthropic’s Claude Opus AI model […]
